snippet.title: Fantasy Maiden Wars: Dream of the Stray Dreamer - Official PC & Nintendo Switch Release Date Trailer
snippet.description: Don't miss the PC & Nintendo Switch Release Date Trailer for Fantasy Maiden Wars: Dream of the Stray Dreamer, a bullet hell tactical RPG based in the Touhou universe developed by Sanbondo. Players will venture out as Shrine Maiden Reimu and Marisa to save Gensokyo from imminent ruin. Partake in turn-based battles for the realm alongside 70+ Touhou heroines, each with their distinct special skills, Spell Cards, and short or long-range strikes. Fantasy Maiden Wars: Dream of the Stray Dreamer is launching in 2025 for Nintendo Switch and PC (Steam).
